title: Ceremony speed: one make pr, faster remaining wall
objective: Speed the remaining single commit-then-make-pr path on this checkout. git commit stays hookless. make pr stays the only publish command. Do not rebuild tests-once teaching, remediates default, or remediator ingest. Cut the measured leftover: serial local pytest without xdist, a second git fetch after the gate, a second changed-file resolve inside security, and no phase timings to prove the next cut.
success_criteria: A markdown-only tree prints phase timings in .l9/pr/gate-timing.json; scaffolding_ms excluding pytest is recorded and the file is overwritten each gate run.
When --profile local --changed-file selects two or more pytest files, the repo-root suite argv includes -n auto; a one-file selection does not add xdist; command_sequence suites never gain xdist.
open_pr_after_gate.sh does not git fetch origin when .l9/pr/fetch-receipt.json is younger than 60s and records the same BASE_REF SHA the gate just fetched.
run_pr_security.sh with PR_CHANGED_FILE set does not call resolve_changed_files.sh.
make pr-check PASS on this change set; pytest tests/ops/scripts/test_ceremony_speed.py PASS.

in: ops/scripts/run_pr_gate.sh phase timings plus background prefetch of origin BASE_REF
ops/scripts/run_python_test_suites.py local changed-file xdist injection at two or more files

doc_root_surface_impact.reason: Standing publish command stays make pr. Speed is internal to the gate. Tests-once teaching belongs to the sibling publish_ceremony_once plan.
No law change. Fetch reuse and xdist do not alter deny-by-effect or secret-boundary rules.
Happy-path help already says finish then make pr. Do not rewrite additive_only lines for a transparent speed cut.
No new named invariant. Local xdist is an executor flag, not a new law.

risks.risk: xdist worker spawn slower than serial for a one-file selection
risks.mitigation: Inject -n auto only when selected pytest file count is two or more

risks.risk: stale fetch-receipt hides a main-bound collision
risks.mitigation: 60s TTL plus BASE_REF SHA match; on mismatch or missing file, fetch as today

risks.risk: PR_CHANGED_FILE reused after writers rewrote files
risks.mitigation: Writers fail closed on tracked dirt before the reader wave; security runs in the reader wave on the same list the gate resolved before writers. A rewrite aborts the gate.
